meta.siteName: OZ Tymián – horses below the castle
meta.title: Horses below the castle | Krásnohorské Podhradie
meta.description: Time with horses and forest pedagogy in Krásnohorské Podhradie, Slovakia. Led rides for children, creative workshops from natural materials, and the eco-centre being built beside the horses.

home.heroPhotoAlt: Two black horses standing in a snowy paddock, with Krásna Hôrka Castle on the ridge above them.
home.heroSubtitle: We are the Tymián association. Children here meet the horses and the forest alike — calmly, safely, and at their own pace.
home.callNote: The fastest way to settle a date and your child's age is a phone call.
home.introTitle: A place where children meet horses and the forest
home.introBody: On our grounds in Krásnohorské Podhradie we offer real contact with horses and nature – from the first stroke, through caring for the animals, to led rides and creative workshops in the spirit of forest pedagogy. We believe direct contact with an animal teaches children patience, respect and responsibility better than any textbook.
home.ekovanTitle: We are building an eco-centre beside the horses
home.ekovanBody: Through the Ekovan project we are creating a space that joins contact with horses, environmental education and rest in nature.
home.visitBody: You will find us in Krásnohorské Podhradie, within sight of Krásna Hôrka Castle. Please arrange your visit in advance — tell us how old your child is and we will suggest what suits them.
home.servicesSubtitle: Programmes for families with children, school groups and travellers.

about.title: About us
about.lead: OZ Tymián – horses below the castle
about.body1: Our work centres on experiences with horses, nature and environmental education. We believe direct contact with an animal teaches children patience, respect and responsibility better than any textbook.
about.body2: Our grounds are open to visitors all year round – whether you come simply to stroke the horses, to give the children a ride, or to join a creative workshop.
about.value1Body: We work with the horses considerately and at their pace. We teach visitors to read their body language.
about.value2Body: We do environmental education with our hands – in the garden, on the sensory trail, beside the horses.
about.value3Body: Families with children, school groups and travellers are all welcome here.

services.title: Experiences
services.lead: Time with horses and the forest, all year round
services.intro: We adapt each programme to the age and experience of the group. Dates are arranged in advance — call us and we will suggest what will suit your child.

vozenie-deti.title: Led rides for children
vozenie-deti.description: Calm, safe rides in nature – a small child's first contact with a horse, always led on foot.

lesna-pedagogika.title: Forest pedagogy
lesna-pedagogika.description: Discovering the forest with every sense. Experiences that build a relationship with nature and self-confidence.

workshopy.title: Creative workshops
workshopy.description: Making things from the natural materials we find around us. We make, we discover, we experience nature.

jazdenie.title: Horse riding
jazdenie.description: Led riding on the grounds for beginners and the more experienced, always supervised.

zoznamenie-s-konmi.title: Getting to know the horses
zoznamenie-s-konmi.description: Meeting the horses and helping care for them on our grounds: grooming, feeding, getting them ready.

ekocentrum-programy.title: Eco-centre programmes
ekocentrum-programy.description: Environmental education programmes at the eco-centre being built beside the horses.

services.termsPending: Duration, group size and price are agreed by phone.

ekovan.title: Ekovan – the eco-centre beside the horses
ekovan.lead: A space joining contact with horses, environmental education and rest in nature.
ekovan.body: The project aims to create a place for families with children, schools and travellers to have authentic contact with nature and animals.

maringotka.title: Teaching space in a shepherd hut
maringotka.description: Shelter for educational programmes in any weather.

tvoriva-zona.title: Creative and educational zone
tvoriva-zona.description: A place for workshops and for working with school groups.

bylinkova-zahrada.title: Herb garden
bylinkova-zahrada.description: A living textbook – herbs visitors can smell and taste.

jazdiaren.title: Riding arena
jazdiaren.description: A safe space for riding and for working with the horses.

zazemie.title: Visitor facilities
zazemie.description: Seating, shade and somewhere to rest in the middle of nature.

ekovan.statusBody: The project is under construction. We post about each phase on our social channels.

booking.title: Booking
